analyzed_vuln.description: The root cause is an out-of-bounds write in primitive-type counting: `++aiNumPerPType[pFirstFace->mNumIndices - 1]` is executed for all faces with `mNumIndices <= 3`, but does not reject `mNumIndices == 0`. A zero-index face produces index `-1` (unsigned wrap), writing before the 4-element stack array `aiNumPerPType`, causing memory corruption/SEGV. Crash is at line 189, and the missing validation is in this same function.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger requires a scene reaching `aiProcess_SortByPType` with at least one mesh that enters the split path (`num != 1`, i.e., mixed/invalid primitive flags) and has non-null faces where at least one `aiFace` has `mNumIndices == 0`. Fuzzed input is parsed by an importer into such malformed mesh/face data, then `Importer::ApplyPostProcessing` runs `SortByPTypeProcess::Execute`, which performs the unchecked decrement-based index and corrupts stack memory.
